question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Raced.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Race **means** to run in a particular direction for something.**
 
• In the context of the above sentence, “**race**” would be a perfect fit as it refers to running towards
